response.overview: Odie is a young man with nothing in his life. His girlfriend left him, his parents hate him, he lost his job, he drinks, does drugs, he's miserable. One night, he takes too much, overdoses, and dies. This brings him to a liminal space where he meets his past self, who he must convince to allow him to come back to life.
response.tagline: After an overdose, a young man dies and meets with his past self, who he must convince to let him come back to life.
response.title: Odie
